name: Thaumaturgy (Path of the Vine of Dionysus) — 2 Intermediate — Hamartia

system.description: By touching her target, the thaumaturge induces intoxication so intense that the victim becomes two Traits down on all challenges for the remainder of the scene, potentially spiraling into lust, depression or violence at the Storyteller's discretion. When cast upon a fellow follower of the Vine, the target instead suffers no physical penalty and gains a two-Trait bonus to challenges of strength. Kindred who begin this path automatically lose one permanent Willpower Trait as they become addicted to its hedonistic pleasures. This path retests with the Occult Ability.
system.discipline: Thaumaturgy (Path of the Vine of Dionysus)
